description: Ministry of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage - Order to expand Kurunegala Urban Development Area
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land and property matters, specifically the declaration and expansion of the Kurunegala Urban Development Area. It contains detailed descriptions of land boundaries, Grama Niladhari divisions, and metes and bounds for the development area. While it mentions Minister Rauff Hakeem, it does not focus on his appointment or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather uses his ministerial authority to declare land areas for urban development purposes, making it primarily a land-related gazette.
